WITH ssr AS (
    SELECT s_store_id,
           SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ss_net_profit) AS profit,
           SUM(sr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(cs_net_profit) AS profit,
           SUM(cr_return_amount) AS returns,
           SUM(cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT web_site_id,
           SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(ws_net_profit) AS profit,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    GROUP BY web_site_id
),
store_returns AS (
    SELECT sr_store_sk,
           SUM(sr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_returns
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    GROUP BY sr_store_sk
),
catalog_returns AS (
    SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk,
           SUM(cr_return_amount) AS returns,
           SUM(cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    GROUP BY cr_catalog_page_sk
),
web_returns AS (
    SELECT wr_web_site_sk,
           SUM(wr_return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_returns
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    GROUP BY wr_web_site_sk
)
SELECT channel, id, sales, returns, profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           (SUM(profit) - SUM(profit_loss)) AS profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           (SUM(profit) - SUM(profit_loss)) AS profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           SUM(sales) AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           (SUM(profit) - SUM(profit_loss)) AS profit
    FROM wsr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || sr_store_sk AS id,
           0 AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           (-SUM(profit_loss)) AS profit
    FROM store_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cr_catalog_page_sk AS id,
           0 AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           (-SUM(profit_loss)) AS profit
    FROM catalog_returns
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || wr_web_site_sk AS id,
           0 AS sales,
           SUM(returns) AS returns,
           (-SUM(profit_loss)) AS profit
    FROM web_returns
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
